query:
SELECT s.total::numeric(14, 2) AS "total!: Decimal",
               COALESCE(
                   (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM wallet_movements
                    WHERE sale_id = s.id AND kind = 'sale_payment'),
                   0
               )::numeric(14, 2) AS "collected!: Decimal"
        FROM sales s
        WHERE s.id = $1
